# Synthetic fixtures — excluded from research-complete claims

The files in this folder (and `data/normalized/synthetic-fixture-v0.ts`) are
**invented layout/smoke-test records**. They are not Latin America election
research.

Do not:

- cite them as completed coverage
- mix their counts into public “research complete” totals
- treat Fixtureland, Fixture Territory, or office IDs `FIX-*` / `FXT-*` as real polities

When `Latin_America_Races_and_Briefings.zip` arrives, import South America
through the real adapters and keep these fixtures in tests only.
